name: ARA1812
title: Session approved
summary: A session was created and journaled. Its client, author, granted scopes and approval authority are a tracing debug event (not a Console log: every launch and connection begins one); the journal and session.status keep the approval. Separately denied scopes are still reported by ARA1805.
html:
A session was created and journaled. Its client, author, granted scopes and approval authority are a tracing debug event (not a Console log: every launch and connection begins one); the journal and session.status keep the approval. Separately denied scopes are still reported by ARA1805.

#Common causes

  • A successful session.begin, including one created automatically by a CLI or per-connection MCP client.

#Fixes

  • Nothing to fix; retain the returned session handle and inspect session.status when you need its granted scopes or checkpoints.

  • End the session with session.end when the work is finished; its approval is already recorded in the journal.

  • Code: ARA1812

  • Constant: SESSION_APPROVED

  • Reported by: ara-host
